# Looking *closer*. {.display}
:::

::: {style="grid-column:4 / span 5;padding-top:36px"}
<p class="lead-text">From neighbourhoods to geographic data science, and many things in between, plus the research, teaching, the tools that go with them.</p>
<p class="lab" style="text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;font-size:.9rem">
Prof. of Geographic Data Science at the [Centre for Advanced Spatial Analysis (CASA)](http://casa.ucl.ac.uk/) and, for my sins, Head of Department. Currently working on the [No Place Like Home](https://www.nospacelikehome.study/about) project and, hopefully, some AI-Support Research.</p>
:::
